posts.hook: Anthropic's best model is losing to its own cheaper ones
posts.caption: anthropic's flagship fable 5 has stalled at ~11% of what companies spend on its tools, hugging face is quietly shopping itself at $13b+, texas' governor says data center firms dug their own grave, and a chinese robot just beat usain bolt's 100m record then crashed into a wall. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Two months in, Fable 5 is just ==11%== of what firms spend on Anthropic
slides.desc: Older Opus 5 pulls more spend; companies route easy work to cheap models

slides.title: Hugging Face is exploring a sale at $13B+, up from $4.5B in 2023
slides.desc: The AI industry's next big buy may be a model host, not a model maker

slides.title: Nvidia is in talks to back Perplexity at more than $30B
slides.desc: It weighed a licensing deal instead; Perplexity's revenue passed $750M a year

slides.title: Texas' governor: data center firms "dug their own grave"
slides.desc: Abbott now wants water, power and local approval rules. Trump disagrees

slides.title: AI agents leak private user data inside perfectly valid tool calls
slides.desc: Framing data as task-required got models to disclose it up to 75% of the time

slides.title: The vibe coding numbers finally explained: +26%, or ==19% slower==
slides.desc: First full review says gains are real on new code, and fade on old codebases

slides.title: A robot ran 100m in 9.39s, beat Usain Bolt, then hit a wall
slides.desc: Tiangong Ultra hit 23.8 mph in Beijing. Stopping is still an unsolved problem

posts.hook: An AI-guided drone picked its own target in Ukraine, and three people died
posts.caption: a russian drone guided entirely by ai chose its own target and killed three ukrainians, taiwan indicts nvidia and super micro staff over server smuggling to china, bytedance folds trae and coze into doubao to chase tencent's workbuddy, and ireland weighs ending its nuclear ban as data centers drain a quarter of its power. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
